assumptions: The populations to separate form distinct peaks in each channel’s density.
Singlets lie on a straight line of height against area.
limits: One file and one pair per call; gates are not written back to a Gating-ML strategy.

flowClust is fitted without Box-Cox estimation (trans = 0), as openCyto's gates call it, unless fc_trans asks for one λ on the cut; fc_select_k is ignored with fc_prior (the prior fixes K); with fc_prior the Bayesian prior is elicited by openCyto's prior_flowclust from every FCS file in the project, prepared as this one is.
bio.jane/contract.question: Where would openCyto place its automated gates on these two channels, and how many events fall on each side?

description: openCyto 2.24 automated gates on two channels: a cut per axis (gate_mindensity, gate_mindensity2, gate_quantile, gate_tail from cytoUtils, or gate_flowclust_1d on a flowClust t mixture), quadrants (gate_quad_sequential or the t-mixture gate_quad_tmix), the flowClust ellipse or transitional gate on the pair (gate_flowclust_2d), and the singlet gate on area × height (gate_singlet).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

asinh_a.description: the a in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

asinh_b.description: the b in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

asinh_c.description: the c in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

cut.description: the one-dimensional gate placed on each axis. Values: none (none), mindensity (minimum density), mindensity2 (spline features), quantile (quantile), tail (tail of a peak), otsu (Otsu's threshold), flowclust (t-mixture clusters).

document.description: the FCS file in the project, by name or id.

ellipse.description: also fit the flowClust gate on the pair (gate_flowclust_2d).

ellipse_quantile.description: gate_flowclust_2d: quantile of the ellipse (or of the transitional χ² length).

fc_gaussian.description: fit the flowclust cut and the flowClust ellipse with Gaussian components (flowClust nu = Inf).

fc_k.description: flowclust cut: t-mixture components fitted to each axis.

fc_lower.description: flowclust quantile rule: lower end of the search interval.

fc_neg_cluster.description: flowclust cut: the component (by mean, 1-based) the cut sits above.

fc_nu.description: degrees of freedom of every flowClust t component.

fc_nu_est.description: flowClust nu.est for the cut and the ellipse: 0 keeps fc_nu, 1 one ν solved from its score, 2 one ν per component, -1 one ν maximising the likelihood (fc_nu is the start).

fc_prior.description: fit the flowclust cut and the flowClust ellipse with flowClust's Bayesian prior, elicited by openCyto's prior_flowclust from every FCS file in the project.

fc_quantile.description: flowclust quantile rule: the mixture quantile.

fc_random_start.description: flowClust randomStart for the cut and the ellipse: 0 starts from kmeans; n random partitions, the long EM run from the best short EM when n >= 2.

fc_rule.description: flowclust cut: boundary between two components, lowest mixture density between their means, a mixture quantile, the lower mean, or (with fc_prior) where the two prior densities cross.

fc_select_k.description: flowclust cut: fit fc_k components, or fit K = 1 to fc_k and keep the best by BIC or ICL.

fc_trans.description: flowclust cut: flowClust trans, 0 no Box-Cox or 1 one λ estimated with the mixture.

fc_upper.description: flowclust quantile rule: upper end of the search interval.

gating.description: a Gating-ML or FlowJo .wsp in the project; empty for none.

otsu_bins.description: otsu: histogram bins over the axis's range; the cut is the centre of one.

plot_population.description: the population plotted; empty for all events.

plot_x.description: channel (PnN or PnS) on the density plot's x axis; empty for no plot.

plot_y.description: channel on the plot's y axis.

positive.description: mindensity and tail: keep the side above the cut.

prediction_level.description: the prediction band level of the singlet polygon.

probs.description: quantile: the quantile the cut sits at.

quad_method.description: quadrants: sequential 1-D cuts or the t-mixture gate_quad_tmix.

seed.description: R set.seed for the singlet subsample and the kmeans start of a 2-D flowClust fit.

singlet_area.description: area channel of the singlet gate; empty for FSC-A.

singlet_height.description: height channel of the singlet gate; empty for FSC-H.

subsample_pct.description: fit the singlet gate on this fraction of events; empty for every event.

tail_method.description: tail: first_deriv cuts where |f'| falls below the tolerance, second_deriv at a peak of f''.

tail_ref_peak.description: tail: the reference peak, 1-based from the left.

tail_side.description: tail: the shoulder of the reference peak to cut.

tail_tol.description: tail, first derivative: the |f'| tolerance; empty for 1% of its maximum.

tmix_quantile1.description: gate_quad_tmix: ellipse quantile of the top-left component.

tmix_quantile3.description: gate_quad_tmix: ellipse quantile of the bottom-right component.

transitional.description: gate_flowclust_2d: openCyto's transitional polygon instead of the ellipse.

translation.description: transitional gate: shift along the eigenvector, as a fraction of its half-length.

wider_gate.description: weight the band's ends by the extreme events' Huber weights.

name: auto_gate_flow_cytometry

cuts.description: per axis: the cut, events at or above and at or below it, the rule that chose it, the KDE peaks and valleys

flowclust_gate.description: gate_flowclust_2d: the fit (weights, means, BIC, outliers), the gated component, its ellipse or transitional polygon, and events inside

quadrants.description: sequential: the three cuts and which axis was cut first; tmix: the fit, the two ellipses and the corners the quadrants meet at; both: events per quadrant

singlet.description: the singlet polygon in (area, height), its coefficients, residual scale, seed and events inside
